evidence.title: Paper page - MVInpainter: Learning Multi-View Consistent Inpainting to Bridge 2D and 3D Editing

name: MVInpainter
summary: Hugging Face paper page for MVInpainter, which reframes 3D editing as multi-view 2D inpainting with video priors and no camera poses.
description: Paper page for arXiv:2408.08000 (published Aug 15, 2024) with the abstract, an AI-generated summary and community discussion. MVInpainter partially inpaints multi-view images with reference guidance instead of generating novel views from scratch; video priors and slot attention keep views consistent and make training and inference pose-free. The page shows 9 upvotes, 1 citing model and 4 collections.
